title: Vendedor responsável | moda casa
description:
Se você ama decoração, arte, design , acompanha as tendências do mundo da moda e tem o desejo de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, cercado pelas últimas tecnologias e quer desenvolver uma carreira profissional cheia de possibilidades, a ZARA HOME é o seu lugar.
A loja é ritmo, decisão e equipe. É onde as coisas acontecem, onde se vive a moda e onde cada pessoa contribui.
Você fará parte de uma equipe curiosa e criativa, que busca fazer as coisas à sua maneira e se move com entusiasmo até conseguir. Procuramos pessoas que gostem do ritmo, da moda e que transformem o dia a dia a partir do que são.
Oferecemos um salário competitivo, comissão pelas vendas e treinamento desde o primeiro dia, além de oportunidades reais de crescimento.
Aqui você encontrará o espaço e a equipe ideal para continuar crescendo com sua própria visão. Oferecemos um ambiente onde aprender faz parte do dia a dia e onde há espaço para contribuir, errar e evoluir.
Aqui, seu papel é muito mais do que atender. Você observa, propõe, cuida do produto, do espaço, você está lá para os clientes que entram e também para a equipe que trabalha com você.
Como Vendedor Responsável da ZARA HOME você realizará a supervisão do time, garantindo a organização geral da loja, reposição de produtos, controle de entradas e saídas do estoque, abertura e fechamento da loja e quando necessário, operar caixa.
Para isso, desejamos que você se identifique com moda casa, tenha vivência com supervisão de loja e com varejo .
Este pode ser o início da sua história conosco.

title: Infrasecops manager (foco em gestão de vulnerabilidades)
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro
A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce. Fazemos parte da Pago Nxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai . Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade. Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.
Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.
Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.
Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.
Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.
Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.
✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.
Já te imagina sendo Nxter?
Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Infra Sec Ops Manager (Foco em Gestão de Vulnerabilidades) para se juntar ao nosso time.
O que você vai fazer O Gerente de Infra Sec Ops será responsável por liderar uma squad dedicada à gestão contínua de vulnerabilidades, fortalecendo a postura de segurança de toda a organização. Essa liderança garantirá que todo o ciclo de identificação, priorização, correção e validação de vulnerabilidades seja executado com eficiência, alinhado às melhores práticas de mercado e aos requisitos regulatórios de uma empresa altamente crítica (ex.: fintech, pagamentos, serviços financeiros).
Além disso, o gerente atuará na integração com times de infraestrutura, cloud, SRE, segurança, operações e desenvolvimento para assegurar que remediações sejam rápidas, coordenadas e rastreáveis.
Responsabilidades Principais:
1. Liderança & Governança
• Liderar a squad de Infra Sec Ops especializada em Vulnerability Management (VM);
• Definir processos, SLAs, KPIs e OKRs ligados ao ciclo de remediação;
• Ser o ponto focal corporativo para auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a vulnerabilidades;
• Conduzir comitês de risco, fóruns técnicos e reports executivos.
2. Gestão de Vulnerabilidades (Core da Função)
• Garantir execução periódica de scans em ativos on-premises, cloud, containers, aplicações e endpoints;
• Analisar criticidade, correlacionar riscos e priorizar remediações com base em CVSS, EPSS, contexto de negócio e exposição real;
• Criar e revisar dashboards unificados para visibilidade do risco tecnológico;
• Desenvolver playbooks de correção, comunicação e escalonamento;
• Monitorar e exigir cumprimento dos SLAs de correção por cada área responsável.
3. Integração com Times de Infra e Engenharia
Trabalhar junto com equipes de:
• Cloud e Kubernetes (workloads vulneráveis, imagens, containers);
• Infraestrutura (servidores, banco de dados, redes, sistemas legados);
• SRE/Dev Ops (pipelines, automação, Ia C);
• Segurança (IAM, hardening, EDR, SIEM);
• facilitar a execução prática das correções, garantindo engajamento e responsabilidade clara (RACI).
4. Automação & Observabilidade
• Automatizar processos de varredura, priorização e relatórios utilizando APIs dos scanners;
• Integrar ferramentas de vulnerabilidade aos pipelines de CI/CD;
• Criar mecanismos de alerta e monitoramento contínuo do risco;
• Acompanhar a eficácia das correções e validar que remediações realmente fecharam o gap.
5. Conformidade & Auditoria
• Garantir aderência a normas como PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC2, LGPD e requisitos internos;
• Preparar evidências e relatórios de conformidade para órgãos reguladores e auditorias;
• Mapear exceções e documentar riscos residuais de forma clara e executiva.
6. Processos & Melhores Práticas
• Estruturar metodologias e políticas de Vulnerability Management;
• Realizar post-mortems quando vulnerabilidades críticas forem encontradas em produção;
• Implementar a cultura de “Secure by Default” e “Shift Left” em toda a organização.
✅ O que buscamos em você
Ensino superior completo;
Experiência comprovada com gestão de vulnerabilidades em larga escala;
Ferramentas como Qualys;
Ambientes cloud (AWS/Azure);
Kubernetes e containers;
Sistemas Linux/Windows;
Infraestrutura corporativa e redes;
Experiência com Ia C (Terraform/Ansible), pipelines CI/CD e automação;
Vivência com ambientes regulados (fintech, bancos, telecom, e-commerce etc.);
Inglês avançado;
Espanhol desejável.
O que oferecemos

title: Ecocardiografista e ultrassonografista
description:
Vagas: Médico Ecocardiografista e Médico Ultrassonografista (Regime de Plantão Semanal)
Sobre a Clínica:
Somos uma clínica de diagnósticos localizada na Berrini (Brooklin, São Paulo), especializada em exames de alta qualidade e atendimento humanizado. Estamos expandindo nossos serviços e buscamos médicos ecocardiografistas e medicos ultrassonografistas qualificados para integrar nossa equipe em regime parcial, com foco em abrir uma agenda semanal de ecocardiograma e uma de ultrassom.
Descrição das Vagas:
Para Ecocardiografista: Realizar exames de ecocardiograma transtorácico, garantindo precisão diagnóstica e conforto ao paciente.
Para Ultrassonografista: Realizar exames de ultrassonografia geral e Doppler, garantindo precisão diagnóstica e conforto ao paciente.
Atuar em uma manhã/tarde por semana (dia e horário a combinar, com flexibilidade para agenda semanal fixa).
Emitir laudos detalhados e precisos, conforme normas do CFM e protocolos da clínica.
Colaborar com a equipe multidisciplinar para otimizar o fluxo de atendimentos.
Requisitos:
Para Ecocardiografista: Graduação em Medicina com residência ou especialização em Cardiologia ou Diagnóstico por Imagem Cardiovascular.
Para Ultrassonografista: Graduação em Medicina com residência ou especialização em Radiologia/Diagnóstico por Imagem ou Ultrassonografia.
Registro ativo no CRM-SP e título de especialista (preferencialmente pela SBC ou equivalente).
Disponibilidade para uma manhã/tarde semanal (6 horas).
Habilidades de comunicação e empatia com pacientes.
Remuneração:
Para Ecocardiografista: Pagamento fixo por exame realizado: R$ 70.
Para Ultrassonografista: Pagamento fixo por exame realizado: R$ 53,00 por ultrassom geral e R$ 76,00 por Doppler.
Valor minimo garantido de R$450.
Sem vínculo empregatício (regime PJ ou autônomo), com potencial para aumento de volume de exames conforme demanda.

title: Learning experience designer
description:
At Brain Buffet, we create fun, real-world courses that help students learn creative software and earn certifications.
We’re looking for a  Learning Experience Designer  — someone who bridges  education and creativity . You’ll make sure our courses don’t just teach students, but truly engage them. This role is perfect for someone who loves to blend  instructional design, storytelling, and visual creativity  — ensuring that every Brain Buffet course feels dynamic, clear, and unforgettable. If you love spotting small details that make a big difference - from pacing and clarity to those moments where an animation or callout could make content “click” - this role is for you.
  What You’ll Do
Content Development
Review courses at all stages of production (pre-production, production, post-production) to ensure accuracy, clarity, engagement, and pedagogical alignment.
Ensure content design is grounded in evidence-based learning science, instructional strategies, accessibility, and usability principles.
Share thoughtful suggestions with editors, animators, designers and the Creative Director to improve pacing, flow, and visual engagement in ways that support learning outcomes.
Identify and address content gaps, redundancies, or inconsistencies, always considering how pedagogical connections can be strengthened for students.
Review written materials (lesson plans, worksheets, quizzes, and scripts) to ensure they align with learning goals and reinforce the course’s instructional design. Creative Review Watch and analyze video lessons through the student’s eyes — how can we make this  click  better? Suggest creative ideas for editors, such as:
On-screen callouts to reinforce key terms
Animations or zoom-ins to maintain interest
Moments of humor, visuals, or transitions that break monotony
Ensure creative elements enhance, rather than distract from learning.
Work closely with the video and design teams to bring educational content to life — visually and conceptually.
Ensure creative ideas always serve the  learning experience , not just the visuals. Collaborate with the Learning Designer to keep Brain Buffet’s courses interactive, fun, and student-centered.   What We’re Looking For Required:
Strong background in education, instructional design, or curriculum development.
Experience creating or reviewing digital learning content (video-based or e-learning).
Excellent eye for detail, pacing, and visual storytelling.
Ability to give clear, positive, and constructive creative feedback.
Comfortable collaborating with multiple teams (education, editing, design). Nice to have:
Background in media production or creative direction.
Familiarity with certification-based learning or software like Adobe, Autodesk, or Microsoft.
Experience balancing educational objectives with engaging, visual storytelling. Soft Skills We Value at Brain Buffet Team players  who thrive in collaborative environments and believe the best ideas come from working together. People who value  continuous learning and teaching , understanding that growth is a constant part of this role. Respectful communicators  who listen deeply and approach feedback with empathy and clarity. Individuals who work with  purpose  and feel genuinely passionate about education, student success, and making learning meaningful. A positive, solutions-oriented mindset — someone who can navigate challenges with creativity and calm. If you’re passionate about making learning fun and meaningful, we’d love to meet you.
Apply now and bring your creative spark to the Brain Buffet team!
Next steps: 
Write an email to with a cover letter that elaborates why you think you are a good fit for this role. Please include your resume and any relevant portfolio you might want to share with us. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Especialista de controladoria

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Full stack mobile developer
description:
About the Role  
I am supporting a US healthcare client in hiring a Full-Stack Mobile Developer to take end-to-end ownership of their flagship mobile application. In this role, you will serve as the sole mobile developer , responsible for evolving an app that pairs with a Bluetooth-enabled pulse oximeter ring to capture overnight sleep data and securely upload it to the cloud.
You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/. NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.
This is an opportunity to own a critical mobile product in a modern health-tech environment, working with senior engineers to deliver technology that directly impacts patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/. NET), and be capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 
 
Key Responsibilities  

Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter/Dart for i OS and Android. 
Implement and optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
Address Android battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted. NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 
Requirements  

Professional level English comprehension (spoken, reading/writing)
7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
Proven experience with  Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications.  Working knowledge of  C# and. NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services.  Deep understanding of  Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation.  Experience with  Android battery optimization techniques  for background processes.  Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
Experience integrating with  Microsoft Azure services .  Familiarity with  Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics),  Sentry , and  Post Hog .  Advanced English communication skills ( C1 level ), both written and spoken.  Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.   
Technical Skills  
Primary:  Flutter/Dart, Bluetooth LE, i OS, Android  Secondary:  C#,. NET, Azure, Firebase  Tools:  Git Hub, Sentry, Post Hog, App Store Connect, Google Play Console 
What We Offer  

The opportunity to develop innovative health technology with real impact. 
Competitive salary based on experience. 
Professional growth and development opportunities. 
A collaborative team culture that values independence and initiative.

description:
ESPECIALISTA EN MECÁ NICA DE ROCAS, con conocimiento en pastefill . PROPÓ SITO Liderar y supervisar proyectos geotécnicos de relleno de excavaciones, garantizando la seguridad y estabilidad de la mina subterránea, así como la búsqueda de la máxima recuperación del mineral, aplicando su conocimiento especializado en métodos diferenciados de relleno cementado y no cementado. Coordinar las interacciones entre las diferentes áreas para asegurar el cumplimiento del cronograma de relleno de las excavaciones, de acuerdo con los requisitos de producción de la mina. RESPONSABILIDADES Y ATRIBUCIONES Desarrollar el proyecto de mezcla de pastefill para cada especificación de exposición de pasta. Conducir estudios de mezcla, selección de materiales e investigaciones en laboratorio.
Actuar junto con los planificadores de mina para conducir los proyectos de relleno de excavaciones a corto, mediano y largo plazo.
Implementar QA/QC para pastefill y otros métodos de relleno. Capacitar al equipo de laboratorio en control de calidad para pastefill . Desarrollar KPIs y actuar en mejora continua con base en las metas definidas.
Planificar zonas de exclusión, barricadas y áreas de construcción.
Definir métodos de monitoreo/instrumentación del sistema de relleno y barricadas.
Desarrollar el Plan de Gestión de Relleno de Excavaciones.
Implementar métodos de monitoreo y gestión de vacíos.
Ser responsable por la elaboración de informes de calidad y notas técnicas ( stope notes ) de relleno de cada realce. Apoyar en el análisis, actualización y calibración del sistema de distribución de pastefill . Comunicar los procesos y procedimientos de relleno de excavaciones a las áreas relevantes.
Actuar en la optimización de las características del relleno, buscando aumentar la disponibilidad y utilización del sistema, mejorar la resistencia, reducir costos y reforzar la seguridad operacional.
Identificar riesgos potenciales y desarrollar estrategias de mitigación.
Realizar inspecciones y auditorías regulares para verificar la conformidad con las especificaciones. REQUISITOS Y CALIFICACIONES Requisitos obligatorios:
Titulación en Geología, Ingeniería de Minas o Ingeniería Geológica.
Registro profesional activo (CREA o equivalente aplicable).
Idioma: inglés avanzado.
Licencia de conducir categoría B.
Conocimiento en métodos de minería (VRM, Open Stope , Cámaras y Pilares). Experiencia en el área. Requisitos deseables:
Experiencia en Geomecánica/Mecánica de Rocas en mina subterránea.
Experiencia con software de modelamiento geológico como Leapfrog.
Experiencia en monitoreo geotécnico de excavaciones subterráneas.
Conocimiento/experiencia en métodos de relleno cementado como pastefill , CAF, CRF (mezcla, sistema de distribución, instrumentación, barricadas). Experiencia con métodos de diseño de resistencia para diferentes tipos de exposición de paredes.
Manejo de software de Planificación de Mina (Datamine, Deswik).
Familiaridad con diagramas de sistema de distribución de pasta y calibración de modelos.
Experiencia en procesos industriales/mineros.

SOBRE A GCDR – MÉTODO, VERDADE E TRANSFORMAÇÃO REAL

Seu papel não é apenas negociar é orientar com ética, clareza e autoridade. Cada acordo fechado representa uma vida que volta a respirar.
SUAS PRINCIPAIS ENTREGAS
• Atendimento consultivo a pessoas e empresários em situação de endividamento bancário; • Condução de diagnósticos profundos para entender dor, urgência, risco e prioridade; • Realização de contatos ativos (calls, ligações e Whats App) para engajamento e evolução no processo; • Estruturação de estratégias jurídicas e negociais com base na realidade de cada caso; • Montagem de um plano de renegociação claro, seguro e tecnicamente viável; • Condução para fechamento de contratos com transparência, segurança e responsabilidade; • Acompanhamento disciplinado do pipeline, analisando funil, prioridades e taxas de conversão; • Registro detalhado no Software Illex para garantir histórico e tomada de decisão precisa; • Integração direta com a equipe jurídica para garantir execução impecável pós-fechamento.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!
É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.
Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que procuramos?
Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!
- O que você deve ter?

Experiência comprovada em design conversacional, abrangendo o desenvolvimento de chatbots, URA e jornadas no Whats App, incluindo a criação de fluxos conversacionais, scripts e personas.
Conhecimento avançado em mapeamento de jornadas do usuário, elaboração de blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade, utilizando ferramentas e metodologias reconhecidas pelo mercado.
Vivência na definição de estratégias e requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de experiência do usuário (UX) e indicadores de negócio, tais como Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso e CSAT conversacional.

Experiência em ambientes ágeis, com atuação em squads (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração direta com Product Owners (PO) e equipes de engenharia.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!
Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.
Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Estamos selecionando um(a) Tech Lead (. NET & Angular) para atuar em um projeto estratégico em um de nossos principais clientes, uma empresa de alta complexidade e missão crítica no setor de Energia.
Procuramos um profissional Sênior que queira assumir um papel de liderança técnica, sendo a principal ponte entre as áreas de Negócio e os times de desenvolvimento (fábrica).
Seu papel não será o desenvolvimento "hands-on" diário, mas sim a governança técnica, o relacionamento com stakeholders e a orientação da equipe. Você será a referência que entende profundamente da tecnologia para definir soluções, mas também atuará no "incêndio", colocando a mão na massa quando incidentes críticos exigirem sua expertise técnica.
Principais responsabilidades:
Interface de negócio: Ser o canal de comunicação principal com as áreas usuárias , realizando o levantamento de requisitos e traduzindo as necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.
Governança técnica: Orientar a fábrica de software, questionar soluções, validar estimativas e garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência à arquitetura definida.
Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.
Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.
Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy , gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em Open Shift ).
Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):
Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.
Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C#. NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.
Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.
Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.
Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).
Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.
Diferenciais (Desejáveis):
Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).
Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente Open Shift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).
Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.
Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Head of product design (ui/ux, ai-forward) - contractor role
description: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor  Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela  About Downstream  Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.  We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.  The Role  We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.  At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:  Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.  Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.  Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.  Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.  Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.  Responsibilities  Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.  Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.  Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.  Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.  Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.  What We’re Looking For  Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, Saa S, or similar).  AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.  Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.  Technical & design skills:  UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent) Strong UX research and prototyping chops  Design systems and component libraries  Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React) Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows) Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.  Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.  Nice-to-Haves  Experience in marketplaces, logistics, Saa S, or fintech.  Familiarity with B2 B workflows and procurement tools.  Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.  Why Downstream  Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.  Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.  Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.  Competitive salary + equity

title: Sales consultant
description: About Us  Established 20 years ago, Phi Partners is a global technology services consultancy based out of London with an annualized turnover of £50m.  We operate exclusively within capital markets, in the front office, pricing and risk space, covering both business and technology services. With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. We have over 500 consultants supporting more than 80 financial institutions around the world.  Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office! Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.  Role and Career Opportunities  Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.  We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:  In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.  Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.  After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.  Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P& L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.  As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P& L and earnings.  Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven! What we are looking for  Commitment and drive  We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge; people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.  Communication and charisma  Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.  Team spirit  At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).  Life at Phi  Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.  Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.  Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil! Training and Reward  You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.  We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

Sua missão  Gerar um fluxo previsível de marcas brasileiras de porte médio a enterprise, abrir relacionamento com líderes de Marketing (nível C-Level) e construir oportunidades de negócio qualificadas para o time de vendas da Hellotext.  O que você fará  Planejar e executar cadências outbound multicanal (Apollo, Linked In, telefone, Whats App).  Visitar escritórios de marcas-chave em  São Paulo, Rio, BH, Porto Alegre ou outras praças estratégicas.  Criar narrativas de negócio que ressoem com CMOs e VPs de e-commerce.  Colaborar com Produto e Marketing para transformar insights de mercado em novas funcionalidades.  Medir tudo: taxas de abertura, reply, conversão e ROI de cada campanha.  O que você traz 2–5 anos como SDR/BDR ou AE vendendo Saa S/Mar Tech para varejo ou e-commerce.  Histórico comprovado de geração de pipeline (reuniões + valor) no mercado brasileiro.  Português nativo e inglês intermediário-avançado; domínio diário de Apollo e Hub Spot (ou ferramentas equivalentes).  Zero medo de telefone e disponibilidade para viajar ≈ 25 %dentro do Brasil.  Diferenciais (nice-to-have) Negócios fechados ≥ USD 30 k ARR.  Rede de contatos C-Level em varejo/e-commerce.  Experiência mentorando SDRs júnior.  Competências que valorizamos  Prospeção magistral – cold-calling sem desculpas.  Storytelling C-Suite – transforma dados em narrativas claras e convincentes.  Criatividade consultiva – desenha ativações sob medida para marcas top.  Propriedade de pipeline – trata a meta como quota, não só KPI.  Mentalidade de aprendiz – itera, faz A/B tests, compartilha playbooks.  Por que a Hellotext? Produto líder, 100 % focado em comércio eletrônico latino-americano.  Time fundacional: impacto direto na estratégia regional.  Cultura de  propriedade, ação rápida e transparência .  Salário  R$ 12 000 – 16 000/mês  + bônus por metas.  Trabalho  remoto no Brasil com verba para coworking e visitas a clientes.  Como se candidatar  Complete nosso teste on-line (≈ 60 min).  Anexe seu currículo ao final do teste.  Grave um vídeo de 2 min seguindo as instruções finais.  Seu desempenho será avaliado pessoalmente pelo CEO  , então reserve uma hora sem interrupções e dê o melhor de si em uma única sessão.

title: Consultor sênior bloomreach experience manager
description: Visão Geral da Função:  Estamos buscando um Consultor Sênior altamente qualificado e experiente em Bloomreach Experience Manager (br XM) para integrar nossa equipe. Este papel é fundamental para ajudar nossos clientes a projetar, implementar e otimizar suas experiências digitais utilizando a plataforma Bloomreach. O candidato ideal terá profundo conhecimento técnico em br XM e forte compreensão de estratégias de experiência digital. Você atuará como consultor técnico, liderando projetos desde a descoberta até a implantação bem-sucedida, garantindo que nossos clientes obtenham o máximo valor de seu investimento.  Principais Responsabilidades:  Liderança Técnica & Arquitetura:  Liderar o design técnico e arquitetura das soluções Bloomreach Experience Manager, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio e requisitos técnicos dos clientes.  Fornecer orientação especializada sobre melhores práticas para modelagem de conteúdo, desenvolvimento de componentes e gerenciamento de ativos digitais na plataforma br XM.  Conduzir sessões técnicas de descoberta e workshops com clientes e equipes internas para definir os requisitos da solução.  Diagnosticar e resolver questões técnicas complexas relacionadas às implementações de br XM.  Desenvolvimento & Implementação:  Supervisionar a entrega técnica completa dos projetos br XM, incluindo desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.  Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento multifuncionais para garantir a execução fluida dos projetos.  Garantir que as entregas técnicas atendam a altos padrões de qualidade e sejam entregues no prazo.  Mentoria & Compartilhamento de Conhecimento:  Orientar desenvolvedores juniores sobre as melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades do Bloomreach.  Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de metodologias internas, ferramentas e melhores práticas para implementações br XM.  Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tendências e atualizações no espaço de plataformas de experiência digital (DXP) e no roadmap de produtos Bloomreach.  Requisitos Técnicos:  Mais de 5 anos de experiência com plataformas CMS ou DXP de nível empresarial, sendo pelo menos 3 anos focados especificamente no Bloomreach Experience Manager (br XM).  Expertise profunda em desenvolvimento Java e no Spring Framework, incluindo Spring MVC, Spring Boot e Spring Security.  Experiência comprovada com os principais recursos do br XM, como o modelo Headless State (HST), Content as a Service (Caa S) e modelagem avançada de conteúdo.  Forte entendimento da arquitetura baseada em componentes do br XM e experiência no desenvolvimento de componentes personalizados, templates e plugins.  Conhecimento extensivo das APIs nativas do br XM para gerenciamento de conteúdo, usuários e personalização.  Especialização na integração do br XM com sistemas terceiros, como CRMs, PIMs, plataformas de e-commerce (ex: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Hybris) e ferramentas de automação de marketing.  Proficiência em tecnologias modernas de front-end (HTML5, CSS3, Java Script ES6+) e experiência com frameworks populares como React, Angular ou Vue.js para construção de aplicações desacopladas ou headless.  Experiência com ferramentas de build e gerenciamento de dependências (ex: Maven, Gradle) e sistemas de controle de versão (ex: Git).  Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas Dev Ops, incluindo pipelines CI/CD, containerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).  Experiência em tuning de performance e otimização de aplicações br XM, incluindo estratégias de cache e otimização de banco de dados.  Compreensão de tecnologias de busca e sua integração com br XM, especialmente Bloomreach Search ou Apache Solr/Elasticsearch.  Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada, ou experiência prática equivalente.  Qualificações Preferenciais:  Certificação Bloomreach Developer ou Architect.  Experiência com outros componentes da suíte Bloomreach (ex: Bloomreach Search & Merchandising, Bloomreach Engagement).  Experiência em ambiente de desenvolvimento Agile/Scrum.

title: Senior consultant - global transaction banking (gtb)
description: Join NFQ! We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model:  Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .  As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced  Senior Consultant  with strong expertise in  Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).  If you are passionate about  corporate banking solutions  ,  trade finance  , and  cash management  , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.  What You’ll Do  Lead  gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation  to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on  Global Transaction Banking (GTB).  Drive and support initiatives in:  Trade Finance & Working Capital  (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).  Cash Management  (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).  Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables  within defined time and cost parameters .  Prepare and deliver  project reporting  to senior management through presentations and executive updates.  Coordinate  workshops and meetings  with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.  Define and execute  testing initiatives  in collaboration with IT teams.  Ensure  alignment and coordination  between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.  Support  change management  and successful adoption of new systems or processes.  Must-Have Qualifications  Knowledge of  PIX  (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.  Understanding of  Brazilian regulations  (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and  international trade finance standards .  Proven experience participating in the  implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.  Minimum of 3 years of experience  in  financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking  , or related sectors.  Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:  Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).  Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).  Proven skills in  requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .  Familiarity with  corporate banking platforms  such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.  Experience with  digital and API-based GTB solutions .  Fluent English  (written and spoken).  Spanish  is a strong plus.  Nice to Have  Experience with  ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.  Familiarity with  process automation (RPA) and  liquidity dashboards  (Power BI, Tableau).  Experience in  operational and liquidity risk management .  Exposure to  cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .  Proficiency in  agile methodologies  (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.  Relevant certifications such as  CPA-20, CTP, CFA  ; graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.  Preferred Education  Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.  Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:  Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.  MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.  Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.  What We Offer  Opportunity to lead  strategic GTB transformation projects  for top-tier financial institutions.  Work in a  dynamic and international environment  with exposure to high-impact banking initiatives.  Continuous learning, certifications, and  professional development plans .  Language classes to boost your global career.  Flexible work model (Hybrid – São Paulo).  CLT contract benefits:  Health & dental insurance  Life insurance  Meal voucher  Transportation allowance  VR - R$ 800,00 A collaborative work environment, internal events, and global mobility opportunities.   Learn more about us:  nfq.es  |  Linked In NFQ    Location:  São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid) Ready to lead GTB transformation and make an impact in corporate banking? Apply now!

title: 2026 global management trainee program - latam
description: Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.  We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world.  What’s yours?   Position Overview  The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.  Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.  What you'll do  Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.  Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.  Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.  One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.  A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.  Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.  First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.  Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on  Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.  Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.  Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.  Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.  Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.  Qualifications:  To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025 Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.  Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.  Who you are  Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.  Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.  You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.  Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.  Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.  A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.  Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.  Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.  What's in it for you  Competitive compensation package  Generous benefits package  Paid Time Off  Career developmental opportunities  A company culture that prioritizes internal development    Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.  Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply. You can cancel the SMS service at any time. Just text “STOP” to any of our texts to unsubscribe. Message & data rates may apply. Message frequency may vary.  If you have any questions regarding privacy, please read our privacy policy, or terms of use

title: Cabotage coordinator
description: Cabotage Coordinator  Job Title:  Cabotage Coordinator  Location:  São Paulo, Brazil  Terms:  Full Time. On site.  Compensation:  Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.  Company:  Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.  Our Core Business:  Global Dry Bulk Freight  Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation  For more information, you may check our website： Role  Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.  The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.  Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.  This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.  Responsibilities & Duties  a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.  b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.  c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).  d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with  customers.  e. Project monitoring  f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected) Requirements & Skills  a. Ability to multi‐task  b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.  c. Strong verbal and written communication skills  d. Attention to detail.  e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).  f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.  Personal Characteristics  Ambitious |  Enthusiastic | Team player

Responsabilidades: - Liderar e supervisionar a equipe jurídica, garantindo a qualidade técnica dos serviços. - Analisar e revisar petições, pareceres e outros documentos jurídicos. - Planejar e implementar estratégias para atuação em processos administrativos e judiciais no âmbito previdenciário. - Realizar reuniões com clientes para entender demandas e propor soluções. - Gerenciar prazos processuais e garantir o cumprimento de metas e indicadores da área. - Promover a capacitação contínua da equipe e fomentar boas práticas no ambiente de trabalho. title: Public relations manager - latam
description: About Cooler Master  Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.  In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.  Role Overview  Lead public relations for  Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.  You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.  Key Responsibilities  Own the LATAM PR Plan  – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.  Build Media Relationships  – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.  Host Press Briefings & Events  – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.  Coordinate Product Reviews  – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.  Partner Collaboration  – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.  Content Localization  – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.  Monitor & Report  – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.  Maintain Compliance  – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.  Qualifications  Education  : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.  Experience  : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.  Regional Expertise  :  Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.  Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.  Language Skills  :  Fluent in English and either  Portuguese  or  Spanish  (bilingual proficiency preferred).  Execution & Measurement  :  Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.  Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.  Who You Are  A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.  Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.  Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.  Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Analista supply chain
description: Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.  Objetivo do Cargo:  O(a) Analista de Supply III será responsável por liderar iniciativas em toda a cadeia de  Procure-to-Pay  dentro do setor de Oil & Gas, garantindo processos de aquisição eficientes, compliance regulatório e geração de valor por meio da negociação, desenvolvimento de fornecedores e identificação de oportunidades de savings. Atuará de forma transversal, conectando-se com clientes internos, auditoria, análise de custos e estratégia de suprimentos, com foco em excelência operacional, sustentabilidade da cadeia e alinhamento às metas organizacionais.  Responsabilidades  Procura & Negociação:  Liderar processos de Procura para categorias definidas, conduzindo análises de mercado, RFPs, RFQs e negociações complexas, incluindo elaboração de Ordens de Compra de acordo com os termos e condições acordados.  Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com fornecedores-chave, garantindo performance, entregas no prazo, inovação e mitigação de riscos.  Definir e executar estratégias de savings, por meio da análise de gastos, otimizando custos e promovendo eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos.  Implementar contratos e SLAs alinhados às políticas corporativas e às necessidades do negócio.  Análise & Gestão de Performance:  Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO) e estudos comparativos de fornecedores.  Gerenciar dados de procura e gastos, identificando tendências, oportunidades de savings e alavancas de negociação.  Garantir a qualidade das informações em sistemas de gestão (ERP, tracking e dashboards de performance).  Elaborar relatórios executivos e recomendações para a liderança, baseados em dados e benchmarks.  Stakeholder Management & Comunicação:  Atuar como ponto focal entre fornecedores, áreas operacionais e stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.  Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com áreas clientes para definição de prioridades e acompanhamento de performance.  Fornecer suporte em processos de auditoria externa e interna relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos.  Liderança & Desenvolvimento:  Promover boas práticas de Procura e Compliance junto ao time e stakeholders.  Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, propondo inovações em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de compras.  Apoiar treinamentos internos e o desenvolvimento de capacidades em Procurement e Strategic Sourcing.  Requisitos  Obrigatórios:  Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Logística ou áreas correlatas.  Experiência comprovada em Strategic Sourcing, Procurement ou Supply Chain dentro do setor de Oil & Gás.  Forte conhecimento em negociação, gestão de contratos e análise financeira.  Domínio de ERP (preferencialmente JDE ou Oracle) e ferramentas analíticas (Excel avançado, Power BI).  Inglês fluente.  Desejáveis:  Certificações (CPSM, CSCP, CFA ou similares).  Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.  Vivência em empresas globais e ambientes multiculturais.  Conhecimentos básicos sobre gestão de estoques.  Competências & Habilidades:  Visão estratégica aliada à execução tática.  Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas complexos.  Habilidade de negociação e influência em diferentes níveis.  Organização, gestão de múltiplas prioridades e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.  Comunicação clara, assertiva e foco em relacionamento colaborativo.  Capacidade de atuar sob pressão.

We serve researchers globally, from Ph D students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes. You will:  Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.  Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.  Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.  Work on Gen AI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration. A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas: ✔ Transporte e Logística ✔ Energia ✔ Saneamento ✔ Engenharia Industrial ✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações  :  A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Senior backend engineer
description: Role Summary  The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.  Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil  KEY Responsibilities  Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.  Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.  Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.  Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.  Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.  Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.  Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.  Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.  Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.  Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.  Responsibilities And Authorities  Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.  Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.  Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.  Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.  Reporting to the R& D Manager for project assignments and career development.  Internal and External Contacts/Customers  Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.  External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.  Skills  Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and compet Encies  Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.  Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.  Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).  Experience with Git versioning systems.  Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.  Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.  Requirements  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.  Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.  Familiarity with Git versioning systems.  Languages  Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.  Computer Skills  Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.  Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.  Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.  Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.  Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (Rabbit MQ, AMQP, etc).  Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).  Experience  Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.  Minimum 6 years of experience.  Personal qualities  Strong leadership and mentorship skills.  Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.  Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.  Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.  Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.  Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.  Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.  Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon) Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.  Vingcard Athos Team  The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including Io T devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.  We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.  Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us! CONTRACT DETAILS  You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.  Benefits include Vale Refeição.  Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.  We are the ASSA ABLOY Group  Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.  As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.  As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.  Seniority Level  Associate  Industry  IT Services and IT Consulting  Employment Type  Full-time  Job Functions  Project Management  Engineering  Skills  Access Control  Spring Boot  Java  AMQP  Rabbit MQ  Spring MVC  Git  Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Kotlin  Amazon Web Services

title: Netsuite accountant
description: Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients  Location:  Remote – Brazil  Salary:  USD 1,700/month  Schedule:  40 hours/week  About Us  We are a dynamic and growing U. S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with  Net Suite experience  and strong  process enhancement and implementation skills  to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.  MIT — Most Important Thing  The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.  Responsibilities  Accounts Payable & Receivable:  Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.  Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations:  Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in  Net Suite .  Month-End Workbooks:  Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.  Financial Reporting:  Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).  Net Suite:  Utilize Net Suite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.  Communication and Task Management:  Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.  Requirements 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.  Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.  Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in  Net Suite  (or similar ERP) and Excel.  Strong background in  process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.  Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.  Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.  US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.  Experience working with European entities is a plus.  Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.  Working Equipment to start is required.  Working hours based on client  Perks & Benefits  Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays. 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U. S. GAAP, and Net Suite.  Full access to TGG University and learning materials.  Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.
